chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn A'sham from Yunus said:
I asked him about the Takbir of the two Eids: does he raise his hand with every Takbir, or is it sufficient for him to raise it at the first Takbir? He said: 'He raises it with every Takbir.'

key_terms.تَكْبِيرِ الْعِيدَيْنِ: The Takbir (saying Allahu Akbar) during the two Eid festivals

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on raising hands during the Takbirat of Eid prayers?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the fiqh of *raf' al-yadayn* (raising hands) during Eid prayers, with the Imam specifying that the gesture accompanies every individual Takbir rather than just the initial one. This ruling highlights the Shia emphasis on replicating the Prophet’s physical demeanor as an act of reverence and spiritual presence (*khushu*) throughout the entire prayer sequence. It serves as a practical guideline for worshippers to ensure their Eid prayers align with the established Sunnah as transmitted through the Ahl al-Bayt.
